chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said:

Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever desires longevity - though no one truly lasts forever - should eat breakfast early, wear comfortable shoes, wear a light robe, and reduce visits to women.'
ai.seo_question: What are the prophetic recommendations for increasing longevity and health?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) links physical moderation to longevity, emphasizing the importance of early meals, comfortable attire, and regulating sexual desire. This advice reflects the Shia emphasis on *Tibb al-Nabi* (Prophetic medicine), where bodily discipline is seen as a means to preserve health and spiritual vitality.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, “Whoever wants to survive - even though no one will last forever - should start to work early in the morning, wear comfortable shoes and a light robe (and minimum visits to women).
